description: How one asset's perpetual-futures open interest moved over the last 1, 4 and 24 hours on OKX, dYdX and Kraken Futures (the US-reachable venues that publish OI history): current OI in coins, change and % change per window with the price change alongside, the conventional reading (e.g. OI up with price down, typically read as new shorts), and a combined view across venues. Hourly samples. Accepts BTC, BTCUSDT, BTC/USDT or XBT. Venues that fail are listed under errors; the call fails (and is not charged) only if none answers. Costs $0.003 USDC per call.
name: open_interest_change
title: Open interest change
